source_attribution: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project. Upstream head adapted from sgl-project/sglang PR #37462 under Apache-2.0.
modifications: MLX nongated-SiLU lattice transformer, exported QKV layout, learned relative/same-slot additive bias, full-vocabulary candidate confidence features, frozen target embeddings and normalized committed-target-tap anchor
Exact normalized outgoing/incoming-factor cosine similarities and correlation-only left-to-right predecessor-conditioned greedy walk
Reused existing DFlash backbone, grouped-convolution layers, external rejection sampler and APCv2 paired cache contract; no replacement cache/backend
Full trained block computed before proposal truncation, maintaining noncausal lattice and backbone feature dependence
Exact deterministic point-mass proposal distributions for sampled or greedy target verification; no finite-pass stochastic-law claim
Head confidence features exposed separately from point-mass q for online acceptance estimation
Pending final prefill context capability prevents losing the real target anchor; cached context with missing pending features fails closed
CPU-safe strict complete head/backbone/convolution source-schema checks and source tensor byte hashes; unsupported owned LM heads, reduced vocabulary and quantization fail closed

Separate explicit bounded CPU teacher buffer and shadow-head training helper; frozen target/backbone features, emitted teacher prefix censoring after first rejection or teacher leaving candidate set, immutable source head, unselected revision-bound head-only export

Explicit per-layer runtime draft_attention_windows overrides bound committed draft context with rotating KV caches and preserve absolute RoPE offsets; trained source config, full proposal block and ordinary target cache/math are unchanged; setting appears in route receipts and source-bound policy identity

Shadow export rechecks trained geometry and head parameters before publication and records initial-head, frozen-example and final-head hashes; target/draft revision pins are explicitly caller declarations rather than independent teacher attestation

checkpoint_availability.evidence: Current SGLang PR #37462 explicitly states checkpoints are not yet published and its E2E test is disabled pending a published drafter; Hugging Face API search lilicorr returned no models. NVIDIA page and pinned vLLM documentation supply no released checkpoint identifier.
checkpoint_availability.no_substitute: A DFlash2 selector or heuristic lattice cannot stand in for a co-trained LiLiCorr head.

validation: CPU-only independent NumPy parity for attention, learned biases, candidate confidence inputs, factor fusion/cosines and scaled transition table; plain/grouped-convolution strict BF16 tiny artifacts; exact point-mass proposals; full-block prefix preservation; initial/chunked prefill target-anchor parity; APCv2 first-boundary paired resume parity; strict config/schema/conv closure under hard metadata MLX import guard; bounded censored teacher capture and synthetic shadow-head loss decrease without source mutation plus hashed unselected export. No real checkpoint qualification or performance claims. Per-layer finite/full draft-window validation before tensor allocation, 18-position absolute-RoPE context oracle across long chunks and ring wrap, bounded draft KV planes, target greedy equality, sampled target point-mass rejection-law Monte Carlo, APCv2 paired resume and revision separation, exact rollback of both planes and RNG after target failure.
